verdict.rationale: Tilled is an API-first payments platform. Its API is key-authenticated, so it can be driven programmatically without the Dashboard, and it offers a sandbox environment, test card and bank numbers, simulated declines, and a mock card-present provider, which suit automated testing. Some operations, such as batch close, are explicitly available via API. However, many workflows (pricing templates, payouts view, disputes, merchant onboarding) are documented as Dashboard-driven, and nothing documents CI usage specifically. Missing for 10: a CLI or headless tooling, CI/CD integration guidance, programmatic API key provisioning (keys are generated in the Dashboard), and independent hands-on corroboration of automation in CI.
